about: Void is a link-only shelf for things that were vetted and found genuinely valuable, but do not belong in the collection: they are platforms, plugins, dashboards, or infrastructure — not standalone skills — or they duplicate an entry that already exists. Void entries are NOT skills and are never counted anywhere: not in the skills total, not in any category, not in the MCP count, not in tag statistics. Nothing here is vendored; each entry only links to its source. No cap — admission is by merit alone: vetted, genuinely valuable, and not for the main collection. Void never flows into skills.json or mcps.json.

entries.description: A Claude Code plugin that learns reusable skills from successful sessions and manages their lifecycle: merging similar skills, updating stale ones, archiving unused ones, and protecting manually written ones.
entries.name: autoharness
entries.title: AutoHarness
entries.why_not_included: It is a plugin, not a skill: its single SKILL.md routes every change through its own stage_skill tool, which only exists inside the plugin, so there is no importable standalone skill.
entries.why_valuable: The most credible self-learning skill layer in the wild — it turns real session experience into maintained, deduplicated skills instead of letting them rot.

entries.description: Long-term memory system for agents: CLI plus MCP server plus Postgres, with markdown and git as the source of truth and hybrid vector-plus-graph search.
entries.name: gbrain
entries.title: GBrain
entries.why_not_included: Infrastructure, not a skill: its ~80 shipped SKILL.md files are GBrain-operator procedures that only work against a running GBrain instance.
entries.why_valuable: An excellent memory layer, and the memory job is a genuine gap the collection has no entry for — persistent agents need somewhere to remember.

entries.description: Collaborative AI design workspace — desktop app plus CLI plus MCP server — with a library of 565 skills covering design systems, templates, and craft rules.
entries.name: open-design
entries.title: Open Design
entries.why_not_included: A platform, not a skill: its skills are OD-coupled (od: frontmatter, its own design systems and craft rules), and its best skill names — algorithmic-art, color-expert, copywriting, brainstorming — already exist in the collection.
entries.why_valuable: A huge, real design-skill library — the largest single source of design craft in the agent-skill world.

entries.name: langfuse
entries.title: Langfuse
entries.description: Open-source AI engineering platform: AI Gateway, agent observability, evals, and prompt/skill management, built on OpenTelemetry.
entries.why_valuable: The leading open-source observability platform for LLM apps and agents — traces, evals, cost tracking, prompt/skill management; the collection has no observability entry, and the owner builds five AI bots.
entries.why_not_included: A self-hosted platform, not a skill; open-core with paid cloud features.

entries.name: paper-qa
entries.title: paper-qa
entries.description: High-accuracy RAG for answering questions from scientific documents with citations.
entries.why_valuable: The most distinctive missing research tool: citation-grounded Q&A over scientific papers — nothing in the research cluster reads papers.
entries.why_not_included: A Python library/agent, not a skill.

entries.name: youtube-agent-skill
entries.title: YouTube Agent Skill
entries.description: Eleven Claude skills that run a YouTube channel: scripts off 21 hook formulas, title+thumbnail linting, edit decisions, comments, planning, viral-hunting, SEO, shorts, retention, chapters, audit.
entries.why_valuable: Eleven real, focused Claude skills that run a whole YouTube channel end to end — the most complete creator skill pack in the harvest.
entries.why_not_included: A skill pack for YouTube, a platform the owner doesn't use; short-form video is already covered by video and reel-story.

entries.name: reverse-skill
entries.title: reverse-skill
entries.description: Reverse Engineering / Authorized Penetration Testing / Security Research skill router pack — AI-powered routing, on-demand toolchain bootstrapping.
entries.why_valuable: The skill router for RE and security research (44k★) — teaches an agent which tool to reach for (jadx, apktool, Frida, native libs); the owner explicitly asked to hunt hacking/security skills.
entries.why_not_included: 89 skills, heavily offensive (EDR bypass, attack chains); REA already represents reverse-engineering in the main collection.

entries.name: hyperframes
entries.title: Hyperframes
entries.description: Write HTML. Render video. Built for agents.
entries.why_valuable: The agent-native programmatic video engine from HeyGen (84k★) — HTML in, MP4 out, made to be driven by agents.
entries.why_not_included: A render engine, not a skill; the motion cluster already has Remotion (link-only) as its representative.

entries.name: local-deep-research
entries.title: Local Deep Research
entries.description: Local deep-research agent (~95% on SimpleQA per the author); local and cloud LLMs, 10+ search engines incl. arXiv and PubMed.
entries.why_valuable: The research-agent tool the owner asked about — runs locally and free, and actually does multi-step research with sources.
entries.why_not_included: An app/agent, not a skill; needs local models or API keys.

entries.name: appflowy
entries.title: AppFlowy
entries.description: AI collaborative workspace (projects, wikis, teams) where you keep control of your data; local AI via Ollama/LMStudio.
entries.why_valuable: The flagship open-source Notion alternative (78k★) — the most-starred item in the whole harvest, real and actively maintained.
entries.why_not_included: A productivity app, not a skill; outside the agent-skills scope.

entries.name: llama-index
entries.title: llama-index
entries.description: The document processing platform for AI — connect LLMs to documents, files, and external data.
entries.why_valuable: The standard RAG/document framework (52k★) — the research cluster has fetchers and search but no document-processing platform.
entries.why_not_included: A framework, not a skill; huge generic surface.

entries.name: opencreator
entries.title: OpenCreator
entries.description: Open-source AI workspace for creators: video translation and dubbing in 120+ languages, downloader, transcription.
entries.why_valuable: A real creator workspace (14k★) — video dubbing/translation directly useful for the owner's channel and content work.
